I upgraded from a Note 20 Ultra to the Flip 5 just a few days ago, simply because there was an absolutely massive promotional discount (read: it was free w/ a relatively cheap 2 year plan, no hidden loans or anything), all the while wishing they'd done the same thing for the Fold.

Just a few days in, and I can honestly say I no longer feel that way.

Sure the Fold would be way better for reading and stuff, but I own a tablet for that purpose anyway. Meanwhile, the Flip, while shut, helps me keep my social media addiction at bay.

I can still use it to check my apps/messages, email and calendar, can use it as a GPS, a cooking timer to scan my groceries at the local supermarket, to browse spotify and to simply make calls.

The only real reasons so far to flip it open are to browse social media, take pictures and to play games - And being able to truly disconnect those two things from more general phone use is already proving remarkably soothing.

That said... Combine the two, and I'd be an even happier camper. 4-fold phones when?
